plugins.name: memory-ledger
plugins.description: Codex skill and hook adapter for the canonical append-only memory ledger.

plugins.name: advisor
plugins.description: Pair Claude Code and Codex CLI through a shared mailbox, or route a one-shot call to Codex, for a rewrite, an opinion, an adversarial review, or delegated investigation. Runs on Codex CLI or Claude Code — install via `codex plugin add advisor@bootgear`.

plugins.name: deputy
plugins.description: Answer judgement questions from your recorded decisions and pinned assertions, or escalate, with hooks that remind the session to ask the deputy and to record escalated answers. Needs memory-ledger@bootgear.
